import React from 'react';
import renderer from 'react-test-renderer';
import ReceiptEntryScreen from '../src/screens/ReceiptEntryScreen';

function getMarginBottom(style) {
  if (!style) return undefined;
  // style can be an array or object
  if (Array.isArray(style)) {
    return Object.assign({}, ...style).marginBottom;
  }
  return style.marginBottom;
}

function hasNestedMarginBottom12(node) {
  if (!node || typeof node !== 'object') return false;
  const {props, children, type} = node;
  const parentMargin = getMarginBottom(props?.style);
  if (parentMargin === 12 && children) {
    const childArray = Array.isArray(children) ? children : [children];
    for (const child of childArray) {
      if (child && typeof child === 'object') {
        const childMargin = getMarginBottom(child.props?.style);
        if (childMargin === 12) {
          return true;
        }
        if (hasNestedMarginBottom12(child)) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }
  } else if (children) {
    const childArray = Array.isArray(children) ? children : [children];
    for (const child of childArray) {
      if (child && typeof child === 'object' && hasNestedMarginBottom12(child)) {
        return true;
      }
    }
  }
  return false;
}

test('REPRO: Adjust the layout to ensure only a single 12 dp vertical gap between fields (e.g., remove the wrapper margin or set FormField\'s container margin to 0 when wrapped).', () => {
  const navigation = { navigate: jest.fn(), goBack: jest.fn() } as any;
  const component = renderer.create(<ReceiptEntryScreen navigation={navigation} />);
  const tree = component.toJSON();
  const hasNested = hasNestedMarginBottom12(tree);
  expect(hasNested).toBe(false);
});

function getMarginBottom(style) {

  return style.marginBottom;
